description:
To bring his mother back to life, Saeron dedicated his life to finding the Twilight Mirror, a legendary artifact said to grant any wish. But Erie, a powerful half-demon, stands in his way. Though Erie easily defeats him, she lets him pass, certain the mirror’s barrier will stop him. To her shock, Saeron breaks through—only for the mirror to shatter, its shards scattering across the land. Now, bound by fate, Saeron and Erie must retrieve the lost pieces and restore the Twilight Mirror’s power.
